newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: BTC up on foreign listing hopes.
newsitem.headline: BTC up on foreign listing hopes.

text.p: Shopping centre operator BTC jumped 4.93 percent in Ljubljana on Wednesday as investors bought on the expectation that the firm would soon finalise a global depository receipts (GDRs) issue.
At 1020 GMT BTC was 690 tolars up at 14,690 on volume of 388 lots.

Traders traced the gains to a report in the twice weekly Finance newspaper that the British unit of Japan's Nomura would complete the issue on Friday. It said the GDRs were likely to be traded in London and valued the issue at $25-$30 million.
No one at the company was immediately available for comment.
"BTC could move between 14,500 and 15,500 tolars depending on future information about its listing abroad," said Mateja Gubanec, a trader at A bank.
BTC said last month it would raise its equity capital by 1.83 billion tolars ($11.7 million) to 6.64 billion.
The company said it would issue 229,267 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 8,000 tolars each, extending the number of its shares to 830,000.
